description: This file implements the procedures for configuring a User Equipment (UE) in a 5G network, including handling RRC reconfiguration, DRB and SRB management, MAC reconfiguration, and handling handover procedures.

classes.name: ue_configuration_procedure
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the configuration process of a UE, including resource allocation, bearer setup, and reconfiguration procedures.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main execution method for the UE configuration procedure, orchestrating the steps for resource update, bearer management, and MAC reconfiguration.

methods.name: stop_drbs_to_rem
methods.description: Asynchronous method to stop traffic on DRBs that are scheduled for removal.

methods.name: update_ue_context
methods.description: Creates and updates the UE's SRB and DRB contexts, including RLC entities and F1-C bearers.

methods.name: clear_old_ue_context
methods.description: Removes old DRB contexts from the UE executor.

methods.name: update_mac_and_sched
methods.description: Reconfigures MAC layer parameters and scheduling for the UE.

methods.name: make_ue_config_response
methods.description: Constructs a successful UE context update response, including DRB setup results.

methods.name: make_ue_config_failure
methods.description: Constructs a failure response for UE configuration.

methods.name: make_empty_ue_config_response
methods.description: Constructs a success response with no changes.

methods.name: changed_detected
methods.description: Checks if there are any configuration changes to process.

methods.name: handle_conditional_mobility_request
methods.description: Handles conditional mobility requests, such as handover triggers.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reconfiguration_complete_ind
methods.description: Handles the RRC reconfiguration complete indication, flushing buffers as needed.
